chapter: CBSE Class 10 Science - Ch.1 Chemical Reactions and Equations

entries.question: Why do we balance chemical equations?
entries.answer: Ek reaction mein atoms na bante hain na mit te hain (law of conservation of mass). Isliye dono side har element ke atoms equal hone chahiye - isi ko balancing kehte hain. Unbalanced equation galat hota hai kyunki woh mass conserve nahi karta.
entries.source: NCERT Class 10 Science, Ch.1 §1.1.2 (law of conservation of mass)

entries.question: What is a combination reaction?
entries.answer: Jab 2 ya zyada reactants milke SIRF EK product banate hain, woh combination reaction hai. Example: CaO + H2O -> Ca(OH)2 (quicklime + paani = slaked lime). Yaad rakho: A + B -> AB.
entries.source: NCERT Class 10 Science, Ch.1 (Eq. 1.13 and after)

entries.question: What is a decomposition reaction?
entries.answer: Isme EK reactant toot ke 2 ya zyada products banata hai - combination ka ulta. 3 types: thermal (heat se, jaise CaCO3 -> CaO + CO2), electrolytic (electricity se, jaise 2H2O -> 2H2 + O2), photolytic (light se, jaise 2AgCl -> 2Ag + Cl2).

entries.question: What is a displacement reaction?
entries.answer: Zyada reactive element kam reactive element ko uske compound se hata deta hai. Example: Fe + CuSO4 -> FeSO4 + Cu - iron nail blue copper sulphate solution mein daalo, solution green ho jata hai aur nail pe brown copper jamta hai.
entries.source: NCERT Class 10 Science, Ch.1, Activity 1.9 (iron nail in CuSO4)

entries.question: What is a double displacement / precipitation reaction?
entries.answer: Do compounds apne ions exchange karte hain. Agar ek product insoluble solid (precipitate) bane toh use precipitation reaction bhi kehte hain. Example: Na2SO4 + BaCl2 -> BaSO4 (white ppt) + 2NaCl.
entries.source: NCERT Class 10 Science, Ch.1, Activity 1.10 (Na2SO4 + BaCl2)

entries.question: Exothermic vs endothermic?
entries.answer: Exothermic = heat RELEASE hoti hai (jalna, respiration, CaO + paani). Endothermic = heat ABSORB hoti hai (CaCO3 ko heat karna, photosynthesis). Exam tip: 'exo' = exit, heat bahar nikalti hai.

entries.question: What are oxidation and reduction?
entries.answer: Oxidation = oxygen ka judna YA hydrogen ka nikalna. Reduction = oxygen ka nikalna YA hydrogen ka judna. Dono saath mein hote hain - isliye 'redox' reaction. Example: CuO + H2 -> Cu + H2O mein CuO reduce hota hai, H2 oxidise hota hai.

entries.question: What is rancidity?
entries.answer: Jab oil/fat wale food hawa ke oxygen se react karke kharaab smell aur taste de dete hain, use rancidity kehte hain. Rokne ke liye: airtight container, antioxidants (BHA/BHT), ya chips packet mein nitrogen gas bharna.

entries.question: What is corrosion and rusting?
entries.answer: Metal ka dheere-dheere hawa/moisture se react karke kharab hona corrosion hai. Iron ka corrosion = rusting (brown rust, Fe2O3.xH2O). Rokne ke liye painting, oiling, galvanisation (zinc coating) karte hain.
entries.source: NCERT Class 10 Science, Ch.1 §1.3.1 (prevention detail from Ch.3)

entries.question: Why clean magnesium ribbon before burning?
entries.answer: Ribbon ke surface pe magnesium oxide ki layer jam jati hai jo burning rokti hai. Sandpaper se saaf karne se pure magnesium expose hota hai aur woh aache se jalta hai: 2Mg + O2 -> 2MgO (dazzling white light).

entries.question: Why is respiration exothermic?
entries.answer: Digestion mein carbohydrates glucose mein tootte hain. Glucose oxygen ke saath react karke CO2 + water + ENERGY deta hai. Energy release ho rahi hai, isliye respiration exothermic reaction hai.

entries.question: Quicklime, slaked lime and whitewashing?
entries.answer: CaO (quicklime) + H2O -> Ca(OH)2 (slaked lime) + bahut heat. Whitewash mein Ca(OH)2 ka solution lagate hain; woh hawa ke CO2 se 2-3 din mein react karke CaCO3 (chamakta white layer) banata hai.

entries.question: What is electrolysis of water?
entries.answer: Acidified water mein electric current pass karo toh water tootta hai: 2H2O -> 2H2 + O2. Cathode pe hydrogen (double volume), anode pe oxygen. Ye electrolytic decomposition ka classic example hai.

entries.question: Why is AgCl stored in dark bottles?
entries.answer: AgCl sunlight mein toot jata hai (photolytic decomposition): 2AgCl -> 2Ag + Cl2 - grey silver ban jata hai. Isliye light se bachane ke liye dark coloured bottles mein rakhte hain.

entries.question: Heating ferrous sulphate?
entries.answer: Green ferrous sulphate crystals heat karne pe tootte hain: 2FeSO4 -> Fe2O3 + SO2 + SO3. Colour green se brown (Fe2O3) ho jata hai aur sulphur ke oxide gases nikalti hain. Thermal decomposition hai ye.
entries.source: NCERT Class 10 Science, Ch.1, Activity 1.6 (Eq. 2FeSO4 -> Fe2O3 + SO2 + SO3)
